craft_notes: Sthāyin: glide-wonder. Rows: row 3 (even/never frame). Close: being. Rejected: 'drifts' — killed: glides kept; 'Self' capitalized — killed: being kept plain.

lines: Even in waking-difference, it glides in the undifferent;
the perceiver never turns back from its own being.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jāgradādi vibhede 'pi tadabhinne prasarpati | nivartate nijānnaiva svabhāvād upalabdhṛtaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Even in waking-etc. difference, it glides in the undifferent; the perceiver-ness never leaves its own being.
c1_essence: Even in waking-difference: glides undifferent; perceiver never leaves self.
